definition: Arthur Mensch (born 17 July 1992) is a French artificial intelligence researcher and entrepreneur, best known as the co-founder and CEO of the Paris-based AI company Mistral AI.
details: Co-authored the Chinchilla paper at DeepMind before founding Mistral AI, spearheading European frontier and open-weight LLMs. He is one of the most prominent figures in Europe’s AI ecosystem and is often cited in debates on AI policy, sovereign technology, and open models. In 2025, Challenges ranked him among the 500 wealthiest French people. He was included in Time's 100 Most Influential People in AI in 2024, being featured in the list among innovators.

explainer.lead: Arthur Mensch is a French entrepreneur, AI researcher and startup leader (born 1992).

contributions.name: He left in May 2023 to co-found Mistral AI.
In May 2023, Mensch co-founded Mistral AI with Guillaume Lample and Timothée Lacroix.

timeline.what: Receives the Knight of the National Order of Merit
